item.title: Estovia and Karelan delegations resume ceasefire talks in Geneva
item.description: Estovia and Karelan delegations resume ceasefire talks in Geneva. Negotiators from both sides met for a second day at a hotel in Geneva. Mediators said discussions focused on a monitored ceasefire along the border.

item.title: Tamarinda hit by 6.4 magnitude quake; no tsunami warning
item.description: Tamarinda hit by 6.4 magnitude quake; no tsunami warning. At least 12 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said. Rescue teams were searching collapsed buildings in several coastal towns.

item.title: Ostrava Republic votes in tight presidential runoff
item.description: Ostrava Republic votes in tight presidential runoff. Opinion polls had shown the two candidates separated by only a few points.
